EmailTemplate.subject: AI, Chatbots, and the Revenue Cycle- Live Talk Today!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Join us at 12 pm et today for our next installment of Healthy Bites Live, <[[https://www.linkedin.com/events/let-schat-bot-ai-chat-andthedig6806586131333836800/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> featuring Mary Frances Corryell of Ivy.Ai discussing all things related to AI, chatbots, and the digital revolution sweeping the revenue cycle.
Today’s patients have changed. With millennials now reaching mid-adulthood and more seniors using technology due to the pandemic than ever before, the massive rise of digital adoption in healthcare has shifted the types of tools and services that patients demand out of their financial experience. These new innovative ways of approaching patient engagement deliver tremendous benefits for both the revenue cycle and the patient. Tune in to learn some critical strategies for embracing this new digital patient.
Attend Today <[[https://www.linkedin.com/events/let-schat-bot-ai-chat-andthedig6806586131333836800/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
